# Notch

> Notch is a digital loyalty and growth platform for independent cafes in Egypt. Customers collect QR-based visit stamps and rewards, while cafes manage loyalty programs, online menus, and discovery.

## Website

- Home: https://notchloyalty.com/
- About: https://notchloyalty.com/about
- Features: https://notchloyalty.com/features
- How it works: https://notchloyalty.com/how-it-works
- Pricing: https://notchloyalty.com/pricing
